title: Approval button
responsibility: Saves approval of the latest displayed plan or design with its exact contract and selected images.

inputs.name: ApprovalButton.entity
inputs.description: The entity supplies its category, identifier, latest version, and contract hash for the button label, disabled state, and approval payload. A truthy contract hash is required; pages, layouts, and components are also blocked when the selected design has no images, while functions use Plan wording.

examples.title: Approval button
examples.summary: Saves approval of the latest displayed plan or design with its exact contract and selected images.

inputs.name: ApprovalButton.workspace
inputs.description: The workspace store supplies the snapshot writability check, bridge approval method, project context, and refresh method. A missing or nonwritable snapshot blocks approval; failures from the attempted approval or refresh are caught and shown as an alert.

inputs.name: ApprovalButton.design
inputs.description: The displayed design version must match entity.latestVersion for approval to be enabled. The selected images’ SHA-256 values are sent with the approval, and the selected option is included only when design.options is nonempty.

inputs.name: ApprovalButton.approved
inputs.description: True disables the button and changes its label to the approved plan or design version; false leaves the regular Approve <version> label.

inputs.name: ApprovalButton.option
inputs.description: The optional string selects images through optionImages and defaults to the empty string. It is sent with the approval only when design.options is nonempty.

outputs.name: ApprovalButton
outputs.description: Renders an approval button and a note that approval saves the exact plan or design while code starts with a Change request; a caught approval or refresh failure appears as an alert. The button is disabled for a missing or nonwritable snapshot, absent contract hash, image-less page/layout/component, existing approval, in-progress approval, or a version different from latestVersion, and function entities use Plan wording while all other categories use Design wording.
